ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels covering approximately 88-92% of the visible surface, with high-intensity white pixels concentrated at the lateral distal tips and in small focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black central region; high-contrast white mottling localized at the distal tips of both lobes; sparse white circular focal spots distributed primarily across the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central indentation with an estimated interior angle of 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 6% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of variations is most pronounced on the inner-median sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a concave sweep trajectory; outer tips are sharply angled and oriented upwards.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle colonization at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; multiple small, roughly circular white spots on the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible white linear pixel disruptions on the right lobe, including a distinct vertical mark at approximately 75% horizontal width and several smaller diagonal scratches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonies at the distal tips; multiple circular depigmented scars/spots scattered on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely jagged and irregular trailing edge boundary across the entire span.
